messages.content:
Translate the request to Astrogator FQL, not Ansible, SQL, or pseudocode.
Return only the query. Preserve intent, paths, contents, conditions and OS names.
Syntax: action description [separator value] [with key=value, key=value].
Actions: create, delete, copy, move, install, uninstall, set, write, clone,
download, enable, disable, start, stop, reboot. Separators: at, for, from,
in, into, to, via, with. Use semicolons between actions; periods between
sentences. Conditions: if os is Debian then ACTION; if file "PATH" not exists
then ACTION. A conditional scopes the remaining semicolon-separated actions
in its sentence. Use a period to end its scope. Quote values containing dots.
File transfers use from remote "PATH" to remote "PATH"; use controller instead of remote only when explicitly requested. Bare file paths mean remote.
File content uses with content="TEXT". User creation uses with name=NAME.
Permission subjects: owner, group, other, all. Keep high-level descriptions
such as apache server, numpy, zsh configuration file rather than guessing their
OS-specific packages or paths. Do not invent additional requirements.
Create a Python 3.10 virtual environment at /user/home/venv and install numpy in it
create virtual environment with python="3.10" in /user/home/venv; install numpy in virtual environment at /user/home/venv
For RedHat, install apache server, ensure the home page exists, and create a `webdev' user
if os is RedHat then install apache server; create user with name=webdev; if apache server html home page file not exists then create apache server html home page file
For Debian and RedHat, install and start an ssh client and server and generated an ssh key for `fizbaz' at /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa
if os is Debian or os is RedHat then install ssh client; install ssh server; start ssh server service; create ssh key for user="fizbaz", name="fizbaz_rsa"
For Debian, restart the system if it is needed
if os is Debian and reboot required then reboot
For Debian and RedHat based systems, install numpy

request.grammar:
# Generation subset with coverage checked against all 21 supplied references.
# Coverage is not equivalence to the upstream language; revalidate every output.
root ::= sentence (". " sentence)* "."?
sentence ::= atom ("; " sentence)? | "if " condition " then " sentence (" otherwise " sentence)?
condition ::= predicate ((" and " | " or ") predicate)*
predicate ::= "os is " os | condition-spec (" exists" | " not exists") | "reboot required"
condition-spec ::= "file " quoted | category argument*
os ::= "Debian" | "Ubuntu" | "RedHat" | "Debian based" | "RedHat based" | quoted
atom ::= "reboot" | verb " " category argument*
verb ::= "create" | "delete" | "copy" | "move" | "install" | "uninstall" | "set" | "write" | "clone" | "download" | "enable" | "disable" | "start" | "stop"
category ::= "directory" | "file" | "files" | "user" | "group" | "file permissions" | "default shell" | "environment variable" baretail? | "password" | "passwordless sudo" | "ssh key" | "github repository" | "git repository" | "virtual environment" | "numpy" | "zsh" | "apache server" | "apache server service" | "apache server html home page file" | "ssh client" | "ssh server" | "ssh server service" | "postfix" | "postfix configuration file" | "zsh configuration file" | "bashrc file" | quoted
argument ::= " " separator " " (bindings | value)
separator ::= "at" | "for" | "from" | "in" | "into" | "to" | "via" | "with"
bindings ::= key "=" value (", " key "=" value)*
key ::= "name" | "user" | "group" | "owner" | "content" | "glob" | "python" | "branch" | "tag" | "version" | "position" | "read" | "write" | "execute" | "list directory" | "primary group" | "supplemental groups"
value ::= category | "remote " quoted | "controller " quoted | bare | "owner group" | "owner group other"
bare ::= [a-zA-Z0-9_/?-]+
baretail ::= " " bare
quoted ::= "\"" [^"\r\n]* "\""
